title: The Amount a Plan Letter's Share Is Taken On When a Waiting Line Is Settled
content:
The amount on which a plan letter's share is taken, when a waiting crossover line under Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies is settled, is selected from the figures the line records.

| What the line records | The amount the share is taken on |
|---|---|
| The line records the policyholder owing more than the amount recorded as approved, and the plan letter pays charges above the Medicare approved amount | The amount the line records the policyholder owing |
| The line records the policyholder owing no more than the amount recorded as approved, and Medicare has paid part of it | The amount approved less what Medicare paid |
| Neither of those holds | The whole amount recorded as approved |

### The plan letters that pay charges above the approved amount

The first row requires both of its limbs, and its second limb turns on the plan letter. Charges above the Medicare approved amount are paid under Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan G and Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement High Deductible Plan G, and are not paid under Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan A, Plan B, Plan D, Plan K or Plan N. On a letter that does not pay them, the first row is never reached however much the line records the policyholder owing.

The second row is reached where the recorded liability does not exceed the amount recorded as approved and Medicare has paid part of that approved amount; the figure is then the approved amount reduced by what Medicare paid.

Where the recorded liability exceeds the approved amount on a letter that does not pay excess charges, and equally where Medicare has paid nothing of an approved amount the liability does not exceed, the whole amount recorded as approved is taken.

### Hypothetical figures

A line on Plan G recording an amount approved of 240.00 and the policyholder owing 265.00: the liability exceeds the approved amount and that letter pays charges above it, so 265.00 is taken.

A line on Plan D recording an amount approved of 240.00, the policyholder owing 180.00, and Medicare having paid 192.00: the liability does not exceed the approved amount and Medicare has paid part of it, so 240.00 less 192.00, being 48.00, is taken.

A line on Plan D recording an amount approved of 240.00, the policyholder owing 180.00, and Medicare having paid nothing: the whole 240.00 is taken.
